content: आटोपः [आ-तुप्-घञ् पृषो˚ टत्वम् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 Pride, self-conceit, arrogance; साटोपम् proudly, in a stately or majestic manner, frequently used as a stage-direction. .²2 Swelling, spreading, expanding, puffing; <ab>Prov.</ab> फटाटोपो भयंकरः; said also of clouds, अद्यापि साटोपा मेघा दृश्यन्ते <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; <ls>Śi. 3. 74</ls>. .²3 Flatulence (in the belly).
